policy: Prioritize genuine absent-scope positives, then boundary probes and distinct domain combinations. PRs 75 and 90 add owner UX. PR 76 probes coordination mentions, 82 probes release and SEO skill names, 88 probes design versus product discovery. PRs 79, 100 and 114 add recovery, renderer and browser-measurement combinations. No router output was used for selection.

remainingGaps.magazine-product-discovery: The pool offers Reader Lab specifications and implementations, not owner/reader discovery or product requirements reconciliation. PR 88 open design questions do not establish discovery.
remainingGaps.stack-research-adr: No candidate makes a technology comparison or ADR decision. Font selection and references to existing PostgreSQL requirements are not stack research.
remainingGaps.gas-city-coordinator: PR 76 fixes skill-platform discovery for Gas City installations; it does not plan dispatch or reconcile Beads work. Other candidates only mention coordinator activity in review history.
remainingGaps.release-witness: PR 82 authors the skill rather than applying it to a release. Routine host-check prose in the other candidates is not a release-evidence deliverable.
